1.evidence: Stage0 fixed-source tables and conservative 29.13–41.48% retained draft-conditioned bound

expected_acceptance_reanalysis.reason: Stage 3 judged acceptance by top-1 agreement with the forced token; production uses temperature-1 p/q acceptance, whose expected value per row is sum_t min(p'(t), q'(t)).
expected_acceptance_reanalysis.method: recomputed from the saved P-mode draft and target logits of the final campaign; no GPU rerun
expected_acceptance_reanalysis.support_transform: reference token selector top_k/top_p branch: logit desc with lower id on ties, top_k 20, softmax, smallest prefix reaching 0.95*sum (>=1), renormalise
expected_acceptance_reanalysis.inference: prompt cluster; 20000 bootstrap; two-sided sign-flip; seed 86
expected_acceptance_reanalysis.conclusion: A small positive catch-up effect exists (significant on gfx1030, borderline on gfx1201), concentrated in proposal step 2. Separate catch-up remains net negative and is not adopted. Fused catch-up is not attempted by user decision (ceiling +0.2 to +0.3%).
